pullRequests.head: asm/wait-loops-002EEB00
pullRequests.body:
What
Six 40-byte boot bodies in src/game/002EEB00.c marked ASM_FUNC: func_002F1E60, func_002F29E4, func_002F2A0C, func_002F32AC, func_002F32D4, func_002F4F78. Each is the same wait loop on a hardware channel register (-0x3000 or -0x2C00 off $a0):
lw   $at, off($a0)
nop ; nop ; nop
andi $at, $at, 0x100
nop
bnez $at, <self>
nop
jr   $ra
lui  $ra, 0x7000

They use $at as their working register and write $ra in the return's delay slot, which cc1 never emits. This is AGENTS.md's second "Handwritten…

commits.headline: fix(levels): func_L03_003D20F8 is USA v2.00's own function
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
The function stores six resident bytes at constant addresses (retail's
lui $at,0x1A; sb form). In USA v2.00 those bytes sit 8 bytes further on,
so the code is identical with every address masked and the carry took it
for v1.01's, but v1.01's C cannot build to it (03_endako: instruction at
+0x4c differs) and the release reports disagreed.

Record it in config/us2/not_carried.tsv, as tools/carry.py --demote
does, and rename its catalogue row to func_US2_L03_003D3700 (nothing
calls it with jal, so…
